'''2001 Montreal DPC Yannick Lapointe DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2001 Montreal DPC]]. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-18505">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18505 DeckTech post 18505], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 22 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18505/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18505/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017144458/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18505/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''why Senators use vibrator'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' August 22, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' this deck slow the hell out of your opponent, then Lott grab is dildo and shove it up your a@@

=== Strategy ===

This is the deck i have use at DPC Montréal.

Strategies is pretty simple limit the early damage and wait until you have the card you need, when you have it do what you have to do and win.

Enter the buraucratie suck middle nut, so throw it away for something more usefull.

Yannick ”2001 World Champion” Lapointe
